title: The Passover Lamb
anchor_kjv: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.
thread: The Passover instructions are strangely over-specified - a lamb without blemish, inspected for days, its blood marking the doorframe, not one bone broken. Fourteen centuries later at the cross, soldiers break two men's legs and stop at the third: the lamb was always a portrait of Christ.
